content.text: ISPH (The International School @ ParkCity Hanoi) has only had a sixth form for a short time, so there isn't much destination data yet.
The school opened in 2019 with around 70 students and classes up to Year 8, and its first cohort of A-Level students graduated in 2025.

The school mostly reports the offers students received, not the university each student finally enrolled at.

**Class of 2025 (first graduating class)**
- At graduation, the school reported
39 university offers from 26 universities across 6 countries
in the UK, Australia, Canada, Ireland, Hong Kong and Vietnam

.
- An earlier school post gave different numbers:
offers from 31 institutions across the UK, USA, Canada, Ireland, Hong Kong, Australia and Vietnam

. The two school announcements don't match exactly, possibly because one counts offers from the US and the other doesn't.
- Their A-Level results were
68% of grades at A*–A, 93% at A*–B and 100% at A*–C

.

**Class of 2026 (current applicants)**
- The school says the class has
received over 50 university offers, and the number continues to grow

. Besides well-known universities in the UK and US, some offers came from specialised institutions in science, technology and the creative arts.
- Universities the school has named:
  - **Imperial College London:**
Minh Khue (Year 13) has officially received an offer
Hyun A (Class of 2026) has officially secured an admission offer from Yonsei University, one of Korea's most prestigious and historic institutions.

**In short:** Most ISPH graduates apply to universities in the UK, followed by Australia, Canada, Ireland, Hong Kong, the US, Korea and Vietnam. With only one or two graduating classes, there isn't enough history to judge the school's results reliably. If you're considering the school, ask its university counselling office for the full list of offers and actual enrolments by year. All of these figures come from ISPH's own announcements, not independent sources.
